name: init
command: set -euo pipefail; apk add -q --no-cache aws-cli; mkdir -p /mnt/shared-config/; mkdir -p /mnt/shared-logs/logs; aws s3 cp s3://${s3_bucket_name}/${s3_bucket_key} /mnt/shared-config/observe-agent.yaml; chmod 0644 /mnt/shared-config/observe-agent.yaml; chmod -R 0777 /mnt/shared-logs /mnt/shared-config; echo "Init Completed"; exit 0
